lines: Lightspeed Venture Partners Select IV Mauritius, an Investor Selling Shareholder, is receiving money by selling 13,529,722 shares in the offer for sale.
Proceeds of ₹204.30 crore are scheduled on or about Friday, October 23, 2026, per the offer document's timetable, not yet confirmed by a listing notice.
Retained shares face a 6-month lock-in from allotment, so a later sale could bring further money once that period ends.
Caveat: the average cost of acquisition and pre-offer holding are not confirmed from the documents.
